li.label: shared bed with Master
li.description: I got to curl up right next to my master all night! Keeping them safe, warm, and happy is the best job in the whole world. I’m such a good dog!

li.label: shared bed with Master
li.description: Master let me curl up right against them all night. It was so warm and comfortable—I couldn't stop purring. I love being master's little kitty.

li.label: shared bed with Master
li.description: I pressed close to keep master cozy, letting them rest against my heavy warmth. Knowing I provided comfort to my master makes my docile heart swell with happiness.

li.label: shared bed with Master
li.description: Master kept me by their side all night, using me however they pleased until they fell asleep. My mind is blank and empty, existing only to be a peaceful, compliant doll for my master.

li.label: shared bed with Master
li.description: Master took the bit from my mouth and pulled me close for the night. My limbs were so heavy from a full day of productive work, and sleeping at master's side made all the fatigue melt away.

li.label: shared bed with Pet
li.description: I let my obedient pet doggy sleep right next to me. Giving them a few gentle pats while they drifted off made the night feel so peaceful.

li.label: shared bed with pet
li.description: My sweet pet kitty curled right up against me and purred all night. The soft, rhythmic warmth made it exceptionally easy to relax and get a deep, restful sleep.

li.label: shared bed with pet
li.description: Resting on my cows pillowy breasts and listening to the steady rythm of there breathing lead to a peacful and deep sleep.

li.label: shared bed with pet
li.description: It was delightful pulling my pet doll close and keeping them arranged at my side while I slept. They provided total warmth and comfort without a single complaint or movement.

li.label: shared bed with pet
li.description: I removed my pony's bit and pulled them in close for the night. Their steady, deep breathing after a long day of productive work was exceptionally soothing to wake up to."
